plymouth.name: Omarchy Matrix
plymouth.description: Omarchy's splash with the line from the start of the film.
plymouth.//lines: The four lines from the start of the film, in order.
plymouth.//color: The typed line's colour, as Plymouth wants it: r, g, b in 0..1.
//dialogColor: The passphrase box, a different colour from the lines on purpose: in the
film the terminal runs green and the boxed prompt is an ice blue.
MEASURED, not chosen. Sampled off the frames themselves -- #75C8D9 is the
box's mid-tone, and the close-ups run brighter at #A8D9E4 and #D5F9FA.
What matters is that BLUE sits above green here (B 217 > G 200 > R 117);
the first guess at this was a mint #7FFFE0, green-dominant, and it read
as the wrong colour immediately beside the real thing.
Omit it and the box takes `color`, so an older provider is unaffected.
plymouth.//titles: On the box's rule, the way an old window manager captioned one.
